title: Catch A Canoe & Bicycles Too!
specs: Unique redwood outrigger canoes made from reclaimed redwood barns, ultra-stable and pet friendly
Big River Estuary is 8 miles long, tidal with abundant wildlife including harbor seals, river otters, and many bird species
Mendoléa is a redwood catamaran with electric outboard and sail, spacious and easy to paddle
Children must be at least 10 years old to rent a bike and minors must be accompanied by an adult
Toddlers must weigh over 30 pounds and be at least 2 years old for outrigger rentals
For kayaks, traditional canoes, or SUPs, children must be at least 10 years old
Mendoléa tour can accommodate up to 6 adults, plus 2 kids between 2 and 10, and 1 or 2 dogs under 90 pounds each

blurb: Catch A Canoe & Bicycles Too! rents redwood outriggers, canoes, kayaks, SUPs, and bicycles for exploring the 8-mile Big River Estuary and surrounding trails. They offer guided tours aboard the Mendoléa, a redwood catamaran with electric outboard and sail. The business is located on the grounds of the Stanford Inn Eco Resort and has been operating since 1972.
